verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a local-versus-cloud choice: anything run locally never leaves your machine, so you can keep data on your own hardware, or opt into Ollama's Cloud for larger models. That gives real control over where data lives, but it is a local/cloud switch rather than residency selection. missing for 10: region or residency selection for Ollama Cloud, documentation of where cloud data is stored or retained, independent corroboration.
